snapshot: GUARD-VERIFY-OFFLINE-1: live DDL for the guard_registry rows that carried verified_at NULL (agent_issues #1629 GUARD-REGISTRY-36-UNVERIFIED-1, pillar security)
read_with: per database: SELECT rowid AS ord, type, name, tbl_name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE sql IS NOT NULL AND tbl_name IN (<tables below>) ORDER BY rowid; len = length(sql) and chk = sum(unicode(substr(sql, i, 1)) * ((i % 97) + 1)) for i in 1..len, computed by D1 in the same read. scripts/guard-registry-negative-tests.mjs recomputes len/chk and refuses to run when a DDL text differs from the read.
notes: Schema only, no rows. The tables are every table the guards' triggers write or read, and every live trigger on those tables is included (so a sibling trigger cannot mask or cause an outcome). D1 runs with PRAGMA foreign_keys = 1 (read on qnfo-audit 2026-10-05T18:47Z); the tests run with foreign keys ON.

objects.name: trg_worker_archive_cascade
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_worker_archive_cascade
        AFTER UPDATE OF status ON audit_workers
        WHEN NEW.status = 'archived'
        BEGIN
            UPDATE dns_redirects SET deleted_on = datetime('now'), notes = 'auto-archived: worker deleted'
            WHERE target = NEW.worker_name || '.workers.dev' AND deleted_on IS NULL;
        END

        AFTER INSERT ON audit_workers
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO audit_trail (session_id, project_id, phase, action, evidence, timestamp)
            VALUES ('registry-sync', 'QNFO.INFRA.WORK', 1, 'auto-audit', 'Worker registered: ' || NEW.worker_name, datetime('now'));
        END

objects.name: trg_cascade_subtasks
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_cascade_subtasks
        AFTER UPDATE OF status ON subtasks
        WHEN NEW.status = 'completed'
        BEGIN
            UPDATE tasks_wbs SET status = 'completed', completed_at = datetime('now')
            WHERE task_code = NEW.task_code 
            AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subtasks WHERE task_code = NEW.task_code AND status != 'completed') = 0;
        END

        BEGIN
            UPDATE phases SET status = 'completed', completed_at = datetime('now')

objects.name: trg_cascade_phases

        AFTER UPDATE OF status ON phases
        WHEN NEW.status = 'completed'
        BEGIN
            UPDATE projects SET status = 'completed', completed_at = datetime('now')
            WHERE project_code = NEW.project_code
            AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM phases WHERE project_code = NEW.project_code AND status != 'completed') = 0;
        END

objects.name: trg_dns_pages_fk
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_dns_pages_fk
        AFTER INSERT ON dns_redirects
        WHEN NEW.target LIKE '%.pages.dev'
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO project_state (project_code, snapshot_at, session_id, current_phase, phase_progress, resource_counts)
            VALUES ('QNFO.INFRA.DNS', datetime('now'), 'fk-violation', 0, 0.0, 
            json_object('fk_violation', 'CNAME target ' || NEW.target || ' has no audit_pages entry', 'record_source', NEW.source, 'record_target', NEW.target));
        END

objects.name: trg_pages_domain_check
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_pages_domain_check
        AFTER INSERT ON cf_pages_domain_mappings
        WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dns_redirects WHERE source = NEW.custom_domain AND deleted_on IS NULL) = 0
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO project_state (project_code, snapshot_at, session_id, current_phase, phase_progress, resource_counts)
            VALUES ('QNFO.INFRA.PAGE', datetime('now'), 'fk-violation', 0, 0.0,
            json_object('fk_violation', 'Pages domain ' || NEW.custom_domain || ' has no active CNAME in dns_redirects', 'domain', NEW.custom_domain));
        END

objects.name: emails_selfloop_quarantine
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER emails_selfloop_quarantine AFTER INSERT ON emails FOR EACH ROW WHEN NEW.status = 'received' AND NEW.recipient IN ('alerts@qnfo.org','alerts@qwav.org','alerts@qwav.tech') AND (lower(COALESCE(NEW.subject,'')) LIKE '%health alert%' OR lower(COALESCE(NEW.subject,'')) LIKE '%research-daily-brief%' OR lower(COALESCE(NEW.subject,'')) LIKE '%briefing%' OR lower(COALESCE(NEW.subject,'')) LIKE '%self-check%') BEGIN INSERT INTO email_loop_quarantine (orig_id, message_id, sender, recipient, subject, body_text, classification, status, received_at, reason) VALUES (NEW.id, NEW.message_id, NEW.sender, NEW.recipient, NEW.subject, NEW.body_text, NEW.classification, NEW.status, NEW.received_at, 'self-ingestion loop (issue 951)'); DELETE FROM emails WHERE id = NEW.id; END

objects.name: contact_ledger_unsuppress_guard
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER contact_ledger_unsuppress_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF suppress ON contact_ledger FOR EACH ROW WHEN OLD.suppress = 1 AND NEW.suppress = 0 AND COALESCE(NEW.suppress_reason,'') NOT LIKE 'OVERRIDE:%' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'CONTACT-LEDGER-IMMUTABLE-1: clearing suppression requires suppress_reason set to OVERRIDE:<reason> so the decision is auditable'); END

objects.name: contact_ledger_no_erase_guard
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER contact_ledger_no_erase_guard BEFORE DELETE ON contact_ledger FOR EACH ROW WHEN OLD.suppress = 1 OR COALESCE(OLD.reply_count,0) > 0 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'CONTACT-LEDGER-IMMUTABLE-1: suppressed or already-contacted ledger rows may not be deleted; the never-email-twice rule depends on this record'); END

objects.name: emails_outbound_violation_detect
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER emails_outbound_violation_detect AFTER INSERT ON emails FOR EACH ROW WHEN NEW.status IN ('sent','replied') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM contact_ledger cl WHERE (lower(cl.email) = lower(NEW.recipient) OR lower(COALESCE(cl.person_key,'')) = lower(NEW.recipient)) AND (cl.suppress = 1 OR COALESCE(cl.reply_count,0) > 0)) BEGIN INSERT INTO email_send_violations (recipient, sender, subject, message_id, violation, detail) VALUES (NEW.recipient, NEW.sender, NEW.subject, NEW.message_id, 'UNGATED-SEND-TO-SUPPRESSED-OR-REPEAT', 'a sent record was written for a recipient already suppressed or already contacted; no send path has a pre-send gate (issues 946/952)'); END

objects.name: email_reply_queue_no_machine
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER email_reply_queue_no_machine AFTER INSERT ON email_reply_queue WHEN lower(NEW.sender) LIKE '%cf-bounce%' OR lower(NEW.sender) LIKE '%cfbounces%' OR lower(NEW.sender) LIKE 'srs0=%' OR lower(NEW.sender) LIKE '%noreply%' OR lower(NEW.sender) LIKE '%no-reply%' OR lower(NEW.sender) LIKE '%dmarc%' OR lower(NEW.sender) LIKE '%mailer-daemon%' OR lower(NEW.sender) LIKE '%postmaster%' OR lower(NEW.sender) LIKE '%evalsignal%' BEGIN UPDATE email_reply_queue SET decision='skip', skip_reason='db-trigger: machine/marketing sender terminalized on first touch', updated_at=datetime('now') WHERE id=NEW.id; END

objects.name: email_first_touch_terminal_insert
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER email_first_touch_terminal_insert AFTER INSERT ON emails WHEN NEW.status IN ('received','processed') AND (lower(COALESCE(NEW.sender,'')) LIKE '%cf-bounce%' OR lower(COALESCE(NEW.sender,'')) LIKE '%cfbounces%' OR lower(COALESCE(NEW.sender,'')) LIKE 'srs0=%' OR lower(COALESCE(NEW.sender,'')) LIKE '%noreply%' OR lower(COALESCE(NEW.sender,'')) LIKE '%no-reply%' OR lower(COALESCE(NEW.sender,'')) LIKE '%dmarc%' OR lower(COALESCE(NEW.sender,'')) LIKE '%mailer-daemon%' OR lower(COALESCE(NEW.sender,'')) LIKE '%postmaster%' OR lower(COALESCE(NEW.sender,'')) LIKE '%evalsignal%' OR lower(COALESCE(NEW.sender,'')) LIKE '%premiersciencenetwork%' OR lower(COALESCE(NEW.sender,'')) LIKE '%eresearchpapers%' OR lower(COALESCE(NEW.sender,'')) LIKE '%bioenvlifesciences%' OR lower(COALESCE(NEW.subject,'')) LIKE '%publish your preprint%' OR lower(COALESCE(NEW.subject,'')) LIKE '%article submission open-%' OR lower(COALESCE(NEW.subject,'')) LIKE '%reminder to publish your article:%' OR lower(COALESCE(NEW.subject,'')) LIKE '%metered usage%' OR lower(COALESCE(NEW.subject,'')) LIKE '%report domain:%') BEGIN UPDATE emails SET status = CASE WHEN lower(COALESCE(NEW.sender,'')) LIKE '%evalsignal%' OR lower(COALESCE(NEW.sender,'')) LIKE '%premiersciencenetwork%' OR lower(COALESCE(NEW.sender,'')) LIKE '%eresearchpapers%' OR lower(COALESCE(NEW.sender,'')) LIKE '%bioenvlifesciences%' OR lower(COALESCE(NEW.subject,'')) LIKE '%publish your preprint%' OR lower(COALESCE(NEW.subject,'')) LIKE '%article submission open-%' OR lower(COALESCE(NEW.subject,'')) LIKE '%reminder to publish your article:%' THEN 'spam' ELSE 'archived' END WHERE id=NEW.id; END

objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER email_reply_queue_tone_gate_draft BEFORE UPDATE OF draft_text ON email_reply_queue WHEN NEW.draft_text IS NOT NULL AND (lower(NEW.draft_text) LIKE '%cannot support%' OR lower(NEW.draft_text) LIKE '%not interested%' OR lower(NEW.draft_text) LIKE '%unfortunately%' OR lower(NEW.draft_text) LIKE '%reject%' OR lower(NEW.draft_text) LIKE '%decline%' OR lower(NEW.draft_text) LIKE '%not a fit%' OR lower(NEW.draft_text) LIKE '%unable to help%' OR lower(NEW.draft_text) LIKE '%do not contact%') BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'GOOD-VIBES-REPLY-TONE-1: negative/rejection draft blocked at DB layer'); END

objects.name: emails_sent_contact_ledger_upsert
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER emails_sent_contact_ledger_upsert AFTER INSERT ON emails FOR EACH ROW WHEN NEW.status IN ('sent','replied') AND NEW.recipient IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(NEW.recipient))>0 BEGIN INSERT INTO contact_ledger (email, name, first_contact, last_contact, contact_count, status, person_key, suppress, reply_count) VALUES (lower(NEW.recipient), NULL, date(COALESCE(NEW.received_at, datetime('now'))), date(COALESCE(NEW.received_at, datetime('now'))), 1, 'sent-ledger', lower(NEW.recipient), 0, CASE WHEN NEW.status='replied' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ON CONFLICT(email) DO UPDATE SET last_contact=excluded.last_contact, contact_count=COALESCE(contact_ledger.contact_count,0)+1, status=CASE WHEN contact_ledger.status IS NULL OR contact_ledger.status='ledger' THEN 'sent-ledger' ELSE contact_ledger.status END, reply_count=COALESCE(contact_ledger.reply_count,0)+CASE WHEN NEW.status='replied' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END; END

objects.name: email_reply_queue_terminal_parent_guard
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER email_reply_queue_terminal_parent_guard
BEFORE UPDATE OF decision ON email_reply_queue
WHEN NEW.decision IN ('closed','skip')
  AND lower(COALESCE(NEW.skip_reason,'')) LIKE 'terminal-parent%'
  AND (
    COALESCE((SELECT length(body_text) FROM emails WHERE id = NEW.email_id), 0) = 0
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM email_parse_failures f WHERE f.email_id = NEW.email_id AND f.resolved_at IS NULL)
    OR (
      COALESCE(NEW.human_score, 0) >= 2
      AND COALESCE((SELECT status FROM emails WHERE id = NEW.email_id), '') <> 'spam'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM emails o
        WHERE lower(o.sender) LIKE '%qnfo.org%'
          AND lower(o.recipient) LIKE '%' || lower(NEW.sender) || '%'
          AND o.received_at > COALESCE((SELECT received_at FROM emails WHERE id = NEW.email_id), '')
      )
    )
  )
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'EMAIL-REPLY-TERMINAL-PARENT-GUARD-1: terminal-parent closure refused for a human reply with no outbound answer (or an unparsed parent); escalate to the owner instead');
END

objects.name: trg_papers_no_shell_served_ins
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER trg_papers_no_shell_served_ins BEFORE INSERT ON papers FOR EACH ROW WHEN NEW.status IN ('published','superseded','distributed','external_preprint') AND LENGTH(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW.body_md,''))) < 40 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'SHELL-SERVED-BLOCKED NO-SHELL-SERVED-1 (insert): rows in a publicly served status require a non-empty body_md; the renderer manufactures "Full text is being prepared" shells for empty bodies'); END

objects.name: trg_papers_no_shell_served_upd
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER trg_papers_no_shell_served_upd BEFORE UPDATE ON papers FOR EACH ROW WHEN NEW.status IN ('published','superseded','distributed','external_preprint') AND LENGTH(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW.body_md,''))) < 40 AND LENGTH(TRIM(COALESCE(OLD.body_md,''))) >= 40 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'SHELL-SERVED-BLOCKED NO-SHELL-SERVED-1 (update): cannot blank or stub the body of a row in a publicly served status'); END

objects.name: trg_papers_pub_floor_upd3
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER trg_papers_pub_floor_upd3 BEFORE UPDATE ON papers FOR EACH ROW WHEN NEW.status = 'published' AND ((COALESCE(OLD.status,'') <> 'published' AND (LENGTH(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW.body_md,''))) < 20000 OR LOWER(COALESCE(NEW.paper_type,'')) IN ('poster','abstract','slides','section','fragment'))) OR (COALESCE(OLD.status,'') = 'published' AND (LENGTH(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW.body_md,''))) < 8000 OR LENGTH(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW.body_md,'')))*2 < LENGTH(TRIM(COALESCE(OLD.body_md,'')))))) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'PUBLISH-FLOOR-BLOCKED MIN-PAPER-LENGTH-3 (update): cannot publish below 20000 chars or as a non-paper artifact type, and cannot stub or halve an existing published paper'); END

objects.name: trg_papers_pub_floor_ins2
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER trg_papers_pub_floor_ins2 BEFORE INSERT ON papers FOR EACH ROW WHEN NEW.status = 'published' AND (LENGTH(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW.body_md,''))) < 20000 OR LOWER(COALESCE(NEW.paper_type,'')) IN ('poster','abstract','slides','section','fragment')) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'PUBLISH-FLOOR-BLOCKED MIN-PAPER-LENGTH-3 (insert): status=published requires body_md >= 20000 chars; paper_type must not be a non-paper artifact type. NULL paper_type is permitted so the live writer is not broken'); END

objects.name: trg_papers_doi_converge_upd
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER trg_papers_doi_converge_upd AFTER UPDATE OF doi, zenodo_doi, zenodo_url ON papers FOR EACH ROW WHEN NEW.doi LIKE '10.5281/zenodo.%' AND (COALESCE(NEW.zenodo_doi,'') <> NEW.doi OR COALESCE(NEW.zenodo_url,'') = '' OR (NEW.zenodo_url LIKE '%zenodo.org/%' AND NEW.zenodo_url NOT LIKE '%zenodo.org/records/' || substr(NEW.doi, 16)) OR (NEW.zenodo_url LIKE '%doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.%' AND NEW.zenodo_url NOT LIKE '%doi.org/' || NEW.doi)) BEGIN UPDATE papers SET zenodo_doi = NEW.doi, zenodo_url = CASE WHEN COALESCE(NEW.zenodo_url,'') = '' OR NEW.zenodo_url LIKE '%zenodo.org/%' OR (NEW.zenodo_url LIKE '%doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.%' AND NEW.zenodo_url NOT LIKE '%doi.org/' || NEW.doi) THEN 'https://zenodo.org/records/' || substr(NEW.doi, 16) ELSE NEW.zenodo_url END WHERE rowid = NEW.rowid; END
